definitions.explanation: A formal party held after a wedding ceremony to celebrate and officially announce the marriage to guests.

examples.japanese: {披露宴|ひろうえん}には{百人|ひゃくにん}の{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: One hundred guests came to the wedding reception.

examples.japanese: {披露宴|ひろうえん}でスピーチを{頼|たの}まれた。
examples.english: I was asked to give a speech at the wedding reception.

examples.japanese: {披露宴|ひろうえん}は{三時間|さんじかん}ほど{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The wedding reception lasted about three hours.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
A Japanese {披露宴|ひろうえん} typically includes:
- {新郎新婦|しんろうしんぷ}の{入場|にゅうじょう}: entrance of bride and groom
- {祝辞|しゅくじ}: congratulatory speeches
- {乾杯|かんぱい}: toast
- {食事|しょくじ}: meal
- {お色直|いろなお}し: costume change
- {余興|よきょう}: entertainment

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {披露宴|ひろうえん}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a wedding reception
- {披露宴|ひろうえん}に{出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend a wedding reception
- {披露宴|ひろうえん}{会場|かいじょう}: reception venue

RELATED TERMS:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}: wedding ceremony
- {二次会|にじかい}: after-party
- {引出物|ひきでもの}: wedding favor/gift to guests
